description: This file defines the TaxClass controller for the admin interface of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It manages CRUD operations (list, add/edit, delete) for tax classes, including rendering views, handling form submissions via AJAX, and interacting with models for data storage.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax classes within the OpenCart admin panel, extending the base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads language files, sets the page title, prepares breadcrumbs, and renders the main tax class list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to get the list of tax classes; calls getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of tax classes from the model, prepares data including pagination info, and renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a tax class, loading existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX form submissions for creating or updating a tax class, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to delete selected tax classes, ensuring no associated products exist, and checks permissions.
